title: Artifact
description: A pointer to something kept elsewhere: a design file, an issue, a link.
guidance: The record says what the thing is for and why it matters here; the thing itself stays where it is. Never paste a credentialed link — name where the secret lives, never its value.

source.description: What kind of thing is at the other end.

references.description: Another record this one rests on, cites or is about.
